Added persist_strategy_state_mutation repository contract with typed StrategyStateMutation/StrategyStateWriteResult. The transaction inserts strategy_state_events idempotently, locks/version-updates strategy_state only for new events, records writer/run/last_event metadata, and supports expected-version conflicts. Validated with cargo fmt -p nautilus-alpaca, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, and a disposable /tmp Rust harness calling the public method against local Alpaca Postgres: first synthetic entry_accepted write returned Applied version 1, replay returned DuplicateEvent version 1. Verified the DB row had one event and matching snapshot metadata, then deleted the generated smoke account rows.

Wired live option-chain node readiness to require Postgres storage only when live entry submit is requested; it now checks required migration version, acquires and heartbeats a runtime_lease, loads storage-backed state, and passes a StrategyStatePersistenceHandle into AlpacaOptionsEntryStrategy. The strategy refuses live entries when persistence is missing/unhealthy, keeps in-memory state updates immediate, and enqueues accepted plus terminal rejected/denied state mutations through the async sink. Validated with cargo fmt -p nautilus-alpaca, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, and a disposable /tmp harness against local Alpaca Postgres that acquired a lease, enqueued duplicate entry_accepted mutations through the public persistence handle, verified one event plus snapshot version 1 and lease row, then deleted the generated smoke rows.

Postgres durability epic completed. Storage schema now uses sqlx migrations; strategy_state has version/writer/run/event metadata; strategy_state_events and runtime_lease are in Postgres; persist_strategy_state_mutation writes event plus snapshot transactionally and idempotently; the option-chain live node gates live entry submit on storage readiness, migration version, runtime lease, and persistence handle health. Validated with cargo fmt/check and local Alpaca Postgres smoke harnesses for migration application, idempotent state mutation, runtime lease acquisition, async persistence enqueue, and smoke-row cleanup.

Validated with cargo fmt -p nautilus-alpaca, cargo check -p nautilus-alpaca --features live --bins, cargo check -p nautilus-cli, cargo check -p nautilus-persistence --features clickhouse, local Alpaca Postgres migration application via alpaca-sync-strategy-state proving backtest_market_cache is absent and migration 202606230003 is recorded, ClickHouse warehouse migrate/health/quote-smoke via nautilus CLI, docker compose warehouse smoke, and direct ClickHouse row check for source live-validation.

Live market-data dual-write sink wired and validated through the Dockerized Alpaca path.
